                function GetMenuLevelNum(li) {
                    var curLevel = 3;
                    if (li.attr("class") != undefined) {
                        var cssClasses = li.attr("class").split(' ');
                        for (var i = 0; i
        < cssClasses.length; i++) {
                            if (cssClasses[i].indexOf('courseware_list_1_') != -1) {
                                if (cssClasses[i].substring(18) != "2") {
                                    curLevel = parseInt(cssClasses[i].substring(18));
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return curLevel;
                }
    
                function ShowPartMenu(id) {
                    var curMenu = $("#liSCO_" + id);
                    var cssLevel = GetMenuLevelNum(curMenu);
    
                    if (cssLevel == 3)
                        ShowSubMenu(id, true);
                    else {
                        var curPosition = 0;
                        var menus = curMenu.parent().find('li');
                        for (var i = 0; i < menus.length; i++) {
                            if (menus.eq(i).attr('id') == curMenu.attr('id')) {
                                curPosition = i;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        for (var i = curPosition - 1; i >
          = 0; i--) {
                              if (GetMenuLevelNum(menus.eq(i)) == "3") {
                                  ShowSubMenu(menus.eq(i).attr("id").substring(6), true);
                                  break;
                              }
                          }
                      }
                  }
                  function ShowSubMenu(id, mustOpen) {
                      var curMenu = $("#liSCO_" + id);
    
                      if (mustOpen || curMenu.find('span').hasClass("list_brunch_2"))//展开目录
                      {
                          var cssLevel = GetMenuLevelNum(curMenu);
                          var menus = $('#liSCO_' + id + ' ~ li');
    
                          if (cssLevel > 3)//只打开一层目录
                          {
                              OpenSubMenus(menus, cssLevel, false);
                          }
                          else//打开所有下层目录
                          {
                              //关闭所有Unit当前已打开的Part
                              var openedMenus = curMenu.parent().find('.courseware_list_1_3');//Part
                              for (var i = 0; i
          < openedMenus.length; i++) {
                                  if (openedMenus.eq(i).find('span').hasClass('list_brunch'))
                                      CloseSubMenus(openedMenus.eq(i));
                              }
    
                              OpenSubMenus(menus, cssLevel, true);
                          }
    
                          if (curMenu.find('span').hasClass("list_brunch_2"))
                              curMenu.find('span').removeClass("list_brunch_2").addClass("list_brunch");
                      }
                      else if (curMenu.find('span').hasClass("list_brunch"))//收拢目录
                      {
                          CloseSubMenus(curMenu);
                      }
                  }
    
                  function CloseSubMenus(curMenu) {
                      var cssLevel = GetMenuLevelNum(curMenu);
                      var menus = curMenu.find('~ li');
    
                      var isSameLevel = false;
                      for (var i = 0; i < menus.length; i++) {
                          var curCssLevel = GetMenuLevelNum(menus.eq(i));
                          if (curCssLevel <= cssLevel)
                              break;
                          else
                              menus.eq(i).hide();
                      }
    
                      curMenu.find('span').removeClass("list_brunch").addClass("list_brunch_2");
                  }
                  function OpenSubMenus(menus, cssLevel, openAll) {
                      var isSameLevel = false;
                      for (var i = 0; i < menus.length; i++) {
                          var curCssLevel = GetMenuLevelNum(menus.eq(i));
                          if (curCssLevel <= cssLevel)
                              break;
    
                          if (!openAll && curCssLevel == (cssLevel + 1)) {
                              menus.eq(i).show();
                              if (menus.eq(i).find('span').hasClass('list_brunch')) {
                                  OpenSubMenus(menus.eq(i).find('~ li'), curCssLevel, false);
                              }
                          }
                          else if (openAll && curCssLevel >
            cssLevel) {
                        menus.eq(i).show();
                        var span = menus.eq(i).find('span');
                        if (span.hasClass('list_brunch_2'))
                            span.removeClass('list_brunch_2').addClass('list_brunch');
                    }
                }
            }

      <script language="javascript">
        //禁止使用后退键
                function banBackSpace(e) {
                    var ev = e || window.event;//获取event对象      
                    var obj = ev.target || ev.srcElement;//获取事件源 
                    var t = obj.type || obj.getAttribute('type'); //获取事件源类型
    
                    //获取作为判断条件的事件类型   
                    var vReadOnly = obj.getAttribute('readonly');
                    var vEnabled = obj.getAttribute('enabled');
                    var vEditable = obj.getAttribute("contenteditable");
                    //处理null值情况   
                    vReadOnly = (vReadOnly == null) ? false : vReadOnly;
                    vEnabled = (vEnabled == null) ? true : vEnabled;
    
                    //当敲Backspace键时，事件源类型为密码或单行、多行文本的，   
                    //并且readonly属性为true或enabled属性为false的，则退格键失效   
                    if (ev.keyCode == 8 && (t == "password" || t == "text" || t == "textarea" || t == "application/x-shockwave-flash")
                        && (vReadOnly == true || vEnabled != true))
                        return false;
    
                    //当敲Backspace键时，事件源类型非密码或单行、多行文本的，则退格键失效   
                    if (ev.keyCode == 8 && t != "password" && t != "text" && t != "textarea" && t != "application/x-shockwave-flash" && vEditable == null)
                        return false;
    
                    return true;
                }
    
                //禁止后退键 作用于Firefox、Opera   
                document.onkeypress = banBackSpace;
                //禁止后退键  作用于IE、Chrome   
                document.onkeydown = banBackSpace;

                               void (0);
                           } */
      </script>

                function ReturnMain() {
                    sessionStorage.removeItem("lastscoid");
    
                    //chrome页面离开事件，最新版chrome禁止异步调用ajax，所以返回课程主页需直接调用EndSco
                    if (!hasLeft) {
                        EndSCO(true);
                        hasLeft = true;
                    }
    
                    location.href = 'http://welearn.sflep.com/student/course_info.aspx?cid=339&classid=756167&nocache=' + Math.random();
                }
                function Leave() {
                    if (!hasLeft) {
                        EndSCOBacon();
                    }
                }
    
                /* 检查是否挂机不动，30分钟不动自动返回课程主页 */
                var latestMoveTime = (new Date()).getTime();
                function MoveMouse() {
                    var d = new Date();
                    latestMoveTime = d.getTime();
                }
                function CheckActive() {
                    var d = new Date();
                    if (d.getTime() - latestMoveTime > 1800000) {
                        clearInterval(actTimerID);
                        hasLeft = true;
                        EndSCO(true);
                        alert('检测到已经30分钟没有进行学习，将返回课程主页');
                        ReturnMain();
                    }
                }
                var actTimerID = window.setInterval("CheckActive();", 60000);//每分钟检测一次
    
                function MainFrameClick() {
                    MoveMouse();
                }
                function AttachClick(FrameWindow) {
    
                    try {
                        FrameWindow.document.body.onmouseover = new Function('parent.document.body.click();');
                        //禁止后退键 作用于Firefox、Opera
                        FrameWindow.document.onkeypress = banBackSpace;
                        //禁止后退键  作用于IE、Chrome
                        FrameWindow.document.onkeydown = banBackSpace;
                        /*
                        FrameWindow.window.onpageshow = function (evt) {
                            if (evt.persisted) ReturnMain();
                        }
                        FrameWindow.window.onunload = function () {
                            void (0);
                        }*/
                    } catch (e) { }
    
                    for (var i = 0; i
        < FrameWindow.frames.length; i++) {
                        var frameObj = FrameWindow.frames[i];
                        try {
                            frameObj.document.body.onmouseover = new Function('parent.document.body.click();');
                        }
                        catch (e) { }
                        try {
                            //var cWindow = frameObj.contentWindow;
                            var cWindow = (frameObj.contentWindow || frameObj.contentDocument);
                            cWindow.document.body.onmouseover = new Function('parent.document.body.click();');
                        }
                        catch (e) { }
                    }
                }
    
                /* 选择、切换SCO */
                var scoid = '';
    
                //每1分钟发送保持在线消息
                var keeplearntimeid;
                var isTimeout = false;//用于计时相关
    
                //合并keepsco、updatecmitime、getticket三个接口，减少请求数
                function KeepLearnTimeAndCheckToken() {
                    //console.log("endcaltime=" + endcaltime);
                    if (scoid == '')
                        return;
    
                    //sco学习时间
                    var total_time = API_1484_11.GetValue('cmi.total_time');
                    if (total_time == '')
                        total_time = curSessionTime;
    
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl,
                        data: "action=keepsco_with_getticket_with_updatecmitime&uid=" + userid + "&cid=" + courseid + "&scoid=" + scoid + "&session_time=" + curSessionTime + "&total_time=" + total_time + "&timelimitsec=" + timelimitsec + "&endcaltime=" + endcaltime + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                        type: "POST",
                        success: function (reData) {
                            if (reData.ret == 0 || reData.ret == 1) {
                                //CheckToken
                                if ('1r8c0sj_3noeb2@pass.sflep.com' != '145Expert@sflep.com' && decodeURIComponent(reData.ticket) != studyTicket) {
                                    hasLeft = true;
                                    EndSCO(true);
                                    alert('检测到正在学习另一课件，将返回课程主页');
                                    ReturnMain();
                                }
    
                                //保持计时 keep alive
                                if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                    isTimeout = false;
                                    //更新客户端sco学习时间
                                    if (reData.seconds >
          0) {
                                          UpdateTotalTime_Client(parseInt(reData.seconds));
                                      }
                                  }
                                  //重新开始计时
                                  else if (reData.ret == 1) {
                                      isTimeout = false;
                                  }
                                  if (reData.endcaltime) {
                                      if (endcaltime == false) {//当前未停止计时,需要提示，已经停止的,不在提示
                                          endcaltime = true;
    
                                          $("#divAutoSaveWarning").show().delay(3000).fadeOut(300);
                                      }
                                  }
                              }
                          },
                          error: function (request, status, err) {
                              if (status == "timeout") {
                                  isTimeout = true;
                              }
                          }
                      });
                  }
    
                  function SelectSCO(id) {
    
                      stopStream(false);//切换SCO时停止AI回复，切换时不加载prompt
                      showLoading();
    
                      if (scoid != '') {
                          EndSCO(false);
                      }
                      scoid = id;
    
                      $('.courseware_sidebar').hide("slide", { direction: "right" }, 400, SelectSCOAfter);
                      IsSideShowAI(scoid);
                  }
                  function SelectSCOAfter() {
                      HideTabs();
    
                      API_1484_11 = new LMS(scoid);
    
                      $(".courseware_current").removeClass("courseware_current");
                      $("#liSCO_" + scoid).addClass("courseware_current");
    
                      if (CheckPausing())
                          return;
    
                      if (!CheckNoCaptcha())
                          return;
    
                      loadSco();
                  }
    
                  //检查是否刷课被锁定
                  function CheckPausing() {
                      var isPausing = false;
                      var pausingMinute = 0;
                      $.ajax({
                          async: false,
                          url: ajaxUrl,
                          data: "action=isPausing&uid=" + userid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                          type: "POST",
                          success: function (reData) {
                              isPausing = reData.isPausing;
                              pausingMinute = reData.pausingMinute;
                          }
                      });
    
                      if (isPausing) {
                          if (pausingMinute
          <= 30) {
                              alert("系统监测到刷课行为，锁定" + pausingMinute + "分钟");
                          }
                          else {
                              alert("系统监测到刷课行为，今日已锁定");
                          }
    
                          ReturnMain();
                          return true;
                      }
    
                      return false;
                  }
    
                  //检查是否需要人工验证
                  function CheckNoCaptcha() {
                      var checkResult = 0;
                      $.ajax({
                          async: false,
                          url: ajaxUrl,
                          data: "action=checkNoCaptcha&uid=" + userid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                          type: "POST",
                          success: function (reData) {
                              checkResult = reData.status;
                          }
                      });
    
                      if (checkResult == 0) {
                          ShowNoCaptcha();
                          return false;
                      }
    
                      return true;
                  }
    
                  //触讯数字课程使用，切换当前sco，但不重新加载页面
                  function SelectSamePageSCO(id) {
    
                      //类似SelectSCO
                      if (scoid != '') {
                          EndSCO(false);
                      }
                      scoid = id;
    
                      //类似SelectSCOAfter
                      API_1484_11 = new LMS(scoid);
    
                      $(".courseware_current").removeClass("courseware_current");
                      $("#liSCO_" + scoid).addClass("courseware_current");
    
                      if (CheckPausing())
                          return false;
    
                      if (!CheckNoCaptcha())
                          return false;
    
                      //类似loadSco，但不重新加载页面
                      var idNotFound = false;
                      $.ajax({
                          async: false,
                          url: ajaxUrl,
                          data: "action=scoAddr&cid=" + courseid + "&scoid=" + scoid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                          type: "POST",
                          success: function (reData) {
    
                              if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                  idNotFound = !StartSCO();
                              }
                              else { //scoid不存在
                                  idNotFound = true;
                              }
                          }
                      });
    
                      if (idNotFound)
                          return false;
    
                      sessionStorage.setItem('lastscoid', scoid);
                      return true;
                  }
    
                  function loadSco() {
                      //加载课件
                      $.ajax({
                          async: false,
                          url: ajaxUrl,
                          data: "action=scoAddr&cid=" + courseid + "&scoid=" + scoid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                          type: "POST",
                          success: function (reData) {
    
                              if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                  var info = reData.addr.split('|');
                                  if (info[0].indexOf('?') == -1)
                                      info[0] += "?nocache=" + Math.random();
                                  else
                                      info[0] += "&nocache=" + Math.random();
    
                                  //                        var iframe = document.getElementById("contentFrame");
                                  //                        var subWeb = document.frames ? document.frames["contentFrame"].document : iframe.contentDocument;
                                  //                        subWeb.location.replace(info[0]);
    
                                  document.getElementById('contentFrame').src = info[0];
                                  StartSCO();
                              }
                          }
                      });
    
                      sessionStorage.setItem('lastscoid', scoid);
                  }
    
                  function ShowNoCaptcha() {
                      var modal = $(_.template($('#modal-template-nocaptcha-pop').html())({}))
                          .modal({
                              show: true,
                              keyboard: true
                          })
                          .on('hidden.bs.modal', function () {
                              $(this).find('iframe').html("").attr("src", "");
                              $('#nocaptchaPopModal').remove();
                          });
                  }
    
                  function HideNoCaptcha() {
                      $('#nocaptchaPopModal').remove();
                      $('.modal-backdrop').remove();
                  }
    
                  function NextSCO() {
                      var liCur = $(".courseware_current");
    
                      var lis = liCur.find("~ li:has(a)");
                      //同单元下一条
                      if (lis.length >
            0) {
            for (var i = 0; i
            < lis.length; i++) {
            if (lis.eq(i).find("a").attr("onclick").indexOf("SelectSCO") != -1) {
                //展开所在Part
                if (i >
              0) {    //如果i==0，不管这是不是个Part级的都不用考虑展开
                                          for (var j = i - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                                              if (lis.eq(j).hasClass("courseware_list_1_3")) {
                                                  if (lis.eq(j).find("span").hasClass("list_brunch_2"))
                                                      lis.eq(j).find("a").click();  //展开
                                                  break;
                                              }
                                          }
                                      }
                                      SelectSCO(lis.eq(i).attr("id").substr(6));
                                      break;
                                  }
                              }
                              return;
                          }
    
                          //下一单元
                          var ulUnit = liCur.parent();
                          var units = $(".courseware_list_1_1");
                          var i = 0;
                          for (; i
              < units.length; i++) {
                              if ("ul_" + units.eq(i).attr("id") == ulUnit.attr("id")) {
                                  i++;
                                  break;
                              }
                          }
    
                          //下一单元的第一条
                          if (i < units.length) {
                              lis = units.eq(i).parent().find("li:has(a[onclick*='SelectSCO'])");
                              if (lis.length >
                0) {
                                    //不是Part级的，需要展开所在Part
                                    if (!lis.eq(0).hasClass('courseware_list_1_3')) {
                                        var partLi = units.eq(i).parent().find("li:has(a[onclick*='ShowSubMenu'])").eq(0);
                                        if (partLi.find("span").hasClass("list_brunch_2"))
                                            partLi.find("a").click();
                                    }
                                    SelectSCO(lis.eq(0).attr("id").substr(6));
                                    ddaccordion.expandone("expandable", i, true);
                                    return;
                                }
                            }
    
                            alert("已到达结尾");
                        }
    
                        function PrevSCO() {
    
                            //同单元上一条
                            var liCur = $(".courseware_current");
                            var ulUnit = liCur.parent();
                            var lis = ulUnit.find("li:has(a)");
                            var i = 0;
                            for (; i
                < lis.length; i++) {
                    if (lis.eq(i).attr("id") == liCur.eq(0).attr("id")) {
                        i--;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                for (; i >
                  = 0;) {
                                  if (lis.eq(i).find("a").attr("onclick").indexOf("SelectSCO") != -1)
                                      break;
                                  i--;
                              }
    
                              if (i >= 0) {
                                  //如果不是Part级的，则展开所在Part
                                  if (!lis.eq(i).hasClass("courseware_list_1_3")) {
                                      for (var j = i - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                                          if (lis.eq(j).hasClass("courseware_list_1_3")) {
                                              if (lis.eq(j).find("span").hasClass("list_brunch_2"))
                                                  lis.eq(j).find("a").click();
                                              break;
                                          }
                                      }
                                  }
    
                                  SelectSCO(lis.eq(i).attr("id").substr(6));
                                  return;
                              }
    
                              //上一单元最后一条
                              var units = $(".courseware_list_1_1");
                              i = 0;
                              for (; i
                  < units.length; i++) {
                                  if ("ul_" + units.eq(i).attr("id") == ulUnit.attr("id")) {
                                      i--;
                                      break;
                                  }
                              }
    
                              if (i >
                    = 0) {
                                    lis = units.eq(i).parent().find("li:has(a[onclick*='SelectSCO'])");
                                    if (lis.length > 0) {
                                        //如果不是Part级，展开所在Part
                                        if (!lis.eq(lis.length - 1).hasClass("courseware_list_1_3")) {
                                            var liParts = units.eq(i).parent().find("li:has(a[onclick*='ShowSubMenu'])");
                                            if (liParts.length > 0)
                                                liParts.eq(liParts.length - 1).find("a").click();
                                        }
                                        SelectSCO(lis.eq(lis.length - 1).attr("id").substr(6));
                                        ddaccordion.expandone("expandable", i, true);
                                        return;
                                    }
                                }
    
                                alert("已到达开始");
                            }
    
                            function StartSCO() {
                                endcaltime = false;//开始一个新的SCO,参数重置
                                var info = '';
                                $.ajax({
                                    async: false,
                                    url: ajaxUrl,
                                    data: "action=startsco160928&cid=" + courseid + "&scoid=" + scoid + "&uid=" + userid + "&classid=" + classid + "&tid=-1" + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                    type: "POST",
                                    success: function (reData) {
                                        if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                            //这里修改成复习模式，不开启定时器方法
                                            var enablereview = reData.enableview;
                                            if (enablereview == "true") {
                                                $("#divReview").show().delay(3000).fadeOut(300);
                                            }
                                            else {
                                                info = 'true';
                                                curSessionTime = 0;
                                                isTimeout = false;
                                                keeplearntimeid = setInterval('KeepLearnTimeAndCheckToken()', 60000);
    
                                                timelimitsec = reData.timelitsec;
                                                if (reData.timelitsec != 0 && reData.useSeconds >= reData.timelitsec) {
                                                    endcaltime = true;
                                                }
                                            }
    
                                            //sco配置信息-是否客观练习isscored=="true"（app端需要字符串）
                                            if (reData.configs)
                                                isScoredSco = (reData.configs.isscored == "true");
                                        }
                                    }
                                });
    
                                hideLoading();
    
                                if (info == 'true') {
                                    hasLoadNote = false;
                                    hasLoadDiscuss = false;
                                    //ChangeNoteView('cur');
                                    //ChangeDisType('cur');
                                    return true;
                                }
                                else
                                    return false;
                            }
    
                            var isEndCommit = false;
                            function EndSCO(endSession) {
    
                                if (API_1484_11.comState != "Running")
                                    return false;
    
                                var info = '';
                                var seconds = 0;
                                var progress = 0;
                                var crate = 0;
                                var status = 0;
                                var cstatus = 0;
                                var trycount = 0;
    
                                try {
                                    progress = API_1484_11.GetValue('cmi.progress_measure');
                                    crate = API_1484_11.GetValue('cmi.score.scaled');
                                    status = API_1484_11.GetValue('cmi.success_status');
                                    cstatus = API_1484_11.GetValue('cmi.completion_status');
                                    trycount = API_1484_11.GetValue('cci.retry_count');
                                    if (cstatus == "completed" && !$("#liSCO_" + scoid).hasClass("course_disable")) {
                                        MarkFinishStyle();
                                        UpdateUnitFinishPercent();
                                    }
                                } catch (ex) { }
    
                                clearInterval(keeplearntimeid);
    
                                $.ajax({
                                    async: false,
                                    url: ajaxUrl,
                                    data: "action=savescoinfo160928&cid=" + courseid + "&scoid=" + scoid + "&uid=" + userid + "&progress=" + progress + "&crate=" + crate
                                        + "&status=" + status + "&cstatus=" + cstatus + "&trycount=" + trycount + "&endcaltime=" + endcaltime + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                    type: "POST",
                                    success: function (reData) {
    
                                        if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                            info = 'true';
    
                                            if (reData.isAutoCommit == "true") {
                                                //更新学习时间
                                                UpdateTotalTime_Client(parseInt(reData.seconds));
    
                                                isEndCommit = true;
                                                API_1484_11.Commit("");
                                            }
                                            else {
                                                //更新学习时间
                                                UpdateTotalTime(parseInt(reData.seconds));
                                            }
                                        }
                                    },
                                    error: function (request, status, err) {
                                        if (status == "timeout") {
                                            isTimeout = true;
                                        }
                                    }
                                });
    
                                if (endSession) {
                                    $.ajax({
                                        async: false,
                                        url: ajaxUrl,
                                        data: "action=removeNoCaptcha&uid=" + userid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                        type: "POST",
                                        success: function (reData) { },
                                        error: function (request, status, err) { }
                                    });
                                }
    
                                if (info == 'true')
                                    return true;
                                else
                                    return false;
                            }
    
                            function EndSCOBacon() {
    
                                if (API_1484_11.comState != "Running")
                                    return false;
    
                                var progress = 0;
                                var crate = 0;
                                var status = 0;
                                var cstatus = 0;
                                var trycount = 0;
    
                                try {
                                    progress = API_1484_11.GetValue('cmi.progress_measure');
                                    crate = API_1484_11.GetValue('cmi.score.scaled');
                                    status = API_1484_11.GetValue('cmi.success_status');
                                    cstatus = API_1484_11.GetValue('cmi.completion_status');
                                    trycount = API_1484_11.GetValue('cci.retry_count');
                                } catch (ex) { }
    
    
                                const formData = new FormData();
                                formData.append("action", "savescoinfo160928");
                                formData.append("cid", courseid);
                                formData.append("scoid", scoid);
                                formData.append("uid", userid);
                                formData.append("progress", progress);
                                formData.append("crate", crate);
                                formData.append("status", status);
                                formData.append("cstatus", cstatus);
                                formData.append("trycount", trycount);
                                formData.append("nocache", Math.random());
    
                                navigator.sendBeacon(ajaxUrl, formData);
                            }

                                    type: "POST",
                                    success: function (reData) {
                                        if (reData.ret == 0) {
    
                                        }
                                    }
                                });

                            }
    
                            function UpdateTotalTime_Client(seconds) {
                                if (seconds <= 0)
                                    return;
    
                                curSessionTime += seconds;
    
                                //记录sco学习时间
                                var total_time = API_1484_11.GetValue('cmi.total_time');
    
                                if (total_time == '')
                                    total_time = curSessionTime;
                                else
                                    total_time = parseInt(total_time) + seconds;
    
                                API_1484_11.SetValue('cmi.total_time', total_time);
                                API_1484_11.SetValue('cmi.session_time', curSessionTime);
                            }
    
                            function MarkFinishStyle() {
                                $('#liSCO_' + scoid).addClass("course_disable");
                                if ($('#liSCO_' + scoid).hasClass("courseware_list_1_3"))
                                    return;
    
                                //当前的Level
                                var curLevel = GetMenuLevelNum($('#liSCO_' + scoid));
    
                                //查找上层Level的目录是否需要标注为已完成
                                var lis = $('#liSCO_' + scoid).parent().find("li");
                                var i = 0;
                                for (; i < lis.length; i++) {
                                    if (lis.eq(i).attr("id") == ("liSCO_" + scoid)) {
                                        i--;
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                for (var j = i; j >
                      = 0; j--) {
                                      if (lis.eq(j).hasClass('course_disable'))
                                          continue;
    
                                      var jLevel = GetMenuLevelNum(lis.eq(j));
                                      if (jLevel >= curLevel) {
                                          if (!lis.eq(j).hasClass('course_disable'))
                                              break;
                                          else
                                              continue;
                                      }
                                      else {
                                          var jFinished = true;
                                          var hasChild = false;
                                          for (var k = j + 1; k
                      < lis.length; k++) {
                                              var kLevel = GetMenuLevelNum(lis.eq(k));
                                              if (kLevel <= jLevel) {
                                                  if (!hasChild)
                                                      jFinished = false;
                                                  break;
                                              }
                                              else {
                                                  hasChild = true;
                                                  if (!lis.eq(k).hasClass('course_disable')) {
                                                      jFinished = false;
                                                      break;
                                                  }
                                              }
                                          }
    
                                          if (jFinished)
                                              lis.eq(j).addClass('course_disable');
                                      }
                                  }
                              }
                              function UpdateUnitFinishPercent() {
    
                                  var aScoList = $('#liSCO_' + scoid).parent().find("li a[onclick*='SelectSCO']");
                                  var scoCount = aScoList.length;
                                  var finishCount = 0;
                                  for (var i = 0; i < aScoList.length; i++) {
                                      if (aScoList.eq(i).parent().parent().hasClass('course_disable'))
                                          finishCount++;
                                  }
    
                                  var progress = Math.round(finishCount * 100 / aScoList.length);
                                  var unitid = $('#liSCO_' + scoid).parent().parent().find('div').attr('id');
    
                                  var radialObj = $('#indicatorContainer_' + unitid).data('radialIndicator');
                                  radialObj.value(progress);
                              }

                              //读取学习信息
                              function GetStudyInfo(id) {
    
                                  var info = '';
                                  $.ajax({
                                      async: false,
                                      url: ajaxUrl,
                                      data: "action=getscoinfo_v7&cid=" + courseid + "&scoid=" + id + "&uid=" + userid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                      type: "POST",
                                      success: function (reData) {
                                          if (reData.ret == 0) {
    
                                              info = reData.comment;
    
                                              //如果开放课程,练习修改过，提示重新答题，或返回目录页
                                              if (reData.ociUpdated) {
                                                  if (confirm("该练习内容已发生更改，是否重新答题？"))
                                                      info = "";
                                                  else {
                                                      hasLeft = true;
                                                      ReturnMain();
                                                      return;
                                                  }
                                              }
    
                                              if (info == "")
                                                  info = defaultData;
    
                                              //获取生词表
                                              if (reData.newwords != '') {
                                                  var index = info.indexOf('"new_words":') + 12;
                                                  var infoleftStr = info.substr(0, index);
                                                  var inforightStr = info.substr(index);
                                                  index = inforightStr.indexOf("]");
    
                                                  info = infoleftStr + reData.newwords + inforightStr.substr(index + 1);
                                              }
    
                                              //NPWEB-278
                                              //获取cci.data
                                              if (reData.ccidata != '') {
                                                  if (info.indexOf('"cci":{"data":') != -1) {
                                                      var tmpdata = eval("(" + info + ")");
                                                      var tmpccistr = JSON.stringify(tmpdata.cci.data);
    
                                                      info = info.replace('"cci":{"data":' + tmpccistr + ',', '"cci":{"data":' + reData.ccidata + ',');
                                                  }
                                                  else {
                                                      var index = info.indexOf('"cci":{') + 7;
                                                      var infoleftStr = info.substr(0, index);
                                                      var inforightStr = info.substr(index);
                                                      info = infoleftStr + '"data":' + reData.ccidata + ',' + inforightStr;
                                                  }
                                              }
                                              else if (info.indexOf('"cci":{"data":') == -1) {
                                                  var index = info.indexOf('"cci":{') + 7;
                                                  var infoleftStr = info.substr(0, index);
                                                  var inforightStr = info.substr(index);
                                                  info = infoleftStr + '"data":[],' + inforightStr;
                                              }
                                              //NPWEB-278 end
    
                                              //获取通用数据
                                              if (reData.useradl != '') {
                                                  if (info.indexOf('"adl":{"data":') != -1) {
                                                      index = info.indexOf('"adl":{"data":') + 14;
                                                      var infoleftStr = info.substr(0, index);
                                                      var inforightStr = info.substr(index);
                                                      index = inforightStr.indexOf("]");
    
                                                      info = infoleftStr + reData.useradl + inforightStr.substr(index + 1);
                                                  }
                                                  else {
                                                      var index = info.indexOf('"adl":{') + 7;
                                                      var infoleftStr = info.substr(0, index);
                                                      var inforightStr = info.substr(index);
                                                      info = infoleftStr + '"data":' + reData.useradl + inforightStr;
                                                  }
                                              }
                                              else if (info.indexOf('"adl":{"data":') == -1) {
                                                  var index = info.indexOf('"adl":{') + 7;
                                                  var infoleftStr = info.substr(0, index);
                                                  var inforightStr = info.substr(index);
                                                  info = infoleftStr + '"data":[]' + inforightStr;
                                              }
                                          }
                                      },
                                      error: function (request, status, err) {
                                          if (status == "timeout")
                                              throw "timeout";
                                          else
                                              throw "error";
                                      }
                                  });
    
                                  return info;
                              }
    
                              //保存学习信息
                              function SetStudyInfo(apiObj) {
    
                                  var info = '';
    
                                  //更新生词本、cci.data和通用数据
                                  if (apiObj.newwordchanged) {
                                      try {
                                          var newWordJson = apiObj.GetValue("cci.service.new_words");
    
                                          try {
                                              var nwCount = parseInt(apiObj.GetValue("cci.service.new_words._count"));
                                              for (var i = 0; i < nwCount; i++) {
                                                  apiObj.SetValue("cci.service.new_words." + i + ".sco_information", apiObj.scoid);
                                                  //                            apiObj.SetValue("cci.service.new_words."+i+".course_information", ""+courseid);
                                              }
    
                                              newWordJson = apiObj.GetValue("cci.service.new_words");
                                          }
                                          catch (ex) { }
    
                                          if (newWordJson != undefined) {
                                              $.ajax({
                                                  url: ajaxUrl,
                                                  data: "action=setnewword&uid=" + userid + "&cid=" + courseid + "&data=" + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(newWordJson)) + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                                  type: "POST"
                                              });
                                          }
                                      } catch (ex) { }
                                  }
                                  //NPWEB-278
                                  var ccidataJson = apiObj.GetValue("cci.data");
                                  if (apiObj.ccidatachanged) {
                                      try {
                                          //                    var ccidataJson = apiObj.GetValue("cci.data");
    
                                          try {
                                              var cdCount = parseInt(apiObj.GetValue("cci.data._count"));
                                              for (var i = 0; i < cdCount; i++) {
                                                  apiObj.SetValue("cci.data." + i + ".sco_information", apiObj.scoid);
                                              }
                                              ccidataJson = apiObj.GetValue("cci.data");
                                          }
                                          catch (ex) { }
    
                                          if (ccidataJson != undefined && ccidataJson != "") {
                                              $.ajax({
                                                  url: ajaxUrl,
                                                  data: "action=setccidata&uid=" + userid + "&cid=" + courseid + "&data=" + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(ccidataJson)) + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                                  type: "POST"
                                              });
                                          }
                                      } catch (ex) { }
                                  }
                                  //NPWEB-278 end
                                  if (apiObj.adldatachanged) {
                                      try {
                                          var adlCount = parseInt(apiObj.GetValue("adl.data._count"));
                                          var adlidlist = '';
                                          var adlstorelist = '';
                                          for (var i = 0; i < adlCount; i++) {
                                              var adlid = apiObj.GetValue("adl.data." + i + ".id");
                                              adlidlist += "|" + adlid;
                                              var adlstore = apiObj.GetValue("adl.data." + i + ".store");
                                              adlstorelist += "[ADLDATA]" + adlstore;
                                          }
    
                                          $.post(ajaxUrl, {
                                              action: "setadldata",
                                              cid: courseid,
                                              uid: userid,
                                              adlid: adlidlist,
                                              data: encodeURIComponent(adlstorelist),
                                              nocache: Math.random()
                                          }
                                          );
                                      } catch (ex) { }
                                      apiObj.adldatachanged = false;
                                  }
    
    
                                  //过滤不需要保存在sco中的学习数据
    
                                  //新写法
                                  const dataTmp = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(apiObj.data));
                                  ////去除cci.data
                                  delete dataTmp.cci.data;
                                  ////去除adldata
                                  delete dataTmp.adl.data;
                                  //去除cci.learners
                                  delete dataTmp.cci.learners;
                                  //去除cci.service.class
                                  delete dataTmp.cci.service.class;
                                  //end 新写法
                                  var jsonStr = JSON.stringify(dataTmp);
    
                                  //去除各种sharers,learner_comments         
                                  jsonStr = jsonStr.replace(new RegExp(",\"replies\":\\[.*?\\]", "gm"), '');
                                  jsonStr = jsonStr.replace(new RegExp(",\"learner_comments\":\\[.*?\\]", "gm"), '');
                                  jsonStr = jsonStr.replace(new RegExp(",\"sharers\":\\[.*?\\]", "gm"), '');
    
                                  //交互数据的记录
                                  var interactionsInfo = GetInteractionInfo(apiObj);
    
    
                                  $.ajaxSetup({
                                      async: false
                                  });
    
                                  $.ajax({
                                      type: "post",
                                      url: ajaxUrl,
                                      data: {
                                          action: "setscoinfo",
                                          cid: courseid,
                                          scoid: apiObj.scoid,
                                          uid: userid,
                                          data: jsonStr + '[INTERACTIONINFO]' + interactionsInfo,
                                          isend: isEndCommit,
                                          nocache: Math.random()
                                      },
                                      //                dataType:"json",
                                      success: function (reData) {
                                          isEndCommit = false;
                                          if (reData.ret == 0)
                                              info = reData.info;
                                      },
                                      error: function (request, status, err) {
                                          isEndCommit = false;
                                          if (status == "timeout")
                                              throw "timeout";
                                      }
                                  });
    
                                  $.ajaxSetup({
                                      async: true
                                  });
    
                                  if (info == 'true')
                                      return true;
                                  else
                                      return false;
                              }

                                //平台跳转至指定SCO
                                function GotoSco(id) {
                                    //返回按钮
                                    if (id == "__back") {
                                        ReturnMain();
                                        return;
                                    }
                                    //打开AI伴学
                                    if (id.substring(0, 4) == '__ai') {
                                        gotoAIPartner(id.substring(5));
                                        return;
                                    }
                                    //打开外链
                                    if (id.substring(0, 5) == '__url') {
                                        window.open(id.substring(6), '_blank');
                                        return;
                                    }
                                    //打开笔记菜单
                                    if (id.substring(0, 6) == '__note') {
                                        ShowNote();
                                        return;
                                    }
                                    //打开问答菜单
                                    if (id.substring(0, 9) == '__discuss') {
                                        if (classid <= 0) {
                                            API_1484_11.errcode = "6012";
                                            return false;
                                        }
                                        else {
                                            ShowDiscuss();
                                            return;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    //打开联系客服菜单
                                    if (id.substring(0, 9) == '__contact') {
                                        Feedback();
                                        return;
                                    }
    
                                    //（触讯数字课程试用）无页面跳转切换sco
                                    if (id.substring(0, 8) == '__cursco') {
                                        var succeed = SelectSamePageSCO(id.substring(9));
                                        if (!succeed) {
                                            API_1484_11.errcode = "6012";
                                            return false;
                                        }
                                        return true;
                                    }
    
                                    SelectSCO(id);
                                }

                                function GetLearnerComments(apiObj) {
                                    //获取其他用户评价
                                    $.ajax({
                                        async: false,
                                        url: ajaxUrl,
                                        data: "action=getlearnercomments&cid=" + courseid + "&classid=" + classid + "&uid=" + userid + "&scoid=" + apiObj.scoid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                        dataType: "json",
                                        type: "POST",
                                        success: function (reData) {
                                            if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                                //                        var interactions = apiObj.GetValue("cmi.interactions._children");
                                                var interactionsCount = parseInt(apiObj.GetValue("cmi.interactions._count"));
                                                for (var i = 0; i < interactionsCount; i++) {
                                                    var commentNum = 0;
                                                    for (var j = 0; j < reData.learnercomments.length; j++) {
                                                        if (parseInt(reData.learnercomments[j].interactionNum) == i) {
                                                            var infostr = "cmi.interactions." + i + ".learner_comments." + commentNum;
                                                            apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".isid", reData.learnercomments[j].isid);
                                                            apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".id", reData.learnercomments[j].id);
                                                            apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".name", reData.learnercomments[j].name);
                                                            apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".result", reData.learnercomments[j].result);
                                                            apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".comment", decodeURIComponent(reData.learnercomments[j].comment));
    
                                                            var replies = reData.learnercomments[j].replies;
                                                            if (replies != undefined && replies.length >
                          0) {
                                 for (var x = 0; x
                          < replies.length; x++) {
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".replies." + x + ".isrid", replies[x].isrid);
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".replies." + x + ".id", replies[x].id);
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".replies." + x + ".name", replies[x].name);
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".replies." + x + ".reply", decodeURIComponent(replies[x].reply));
                                                                  }
    
                                                                  apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".reply_count", replies.length);
                                                              }
    
                                                              commentNum++;
                                                          }
                                                      }
                                                  }
                                              }
                                          },
                                          error: function (request, status, err) {
                                              if (status == "timeout")
                                                  throw "timeout";
                                          }
                                      });
                                  }
    
                                  function GetShareInfo(apiObj) {
                                      if (classid == 0)
                                          return;
    
                                      //获取交互分享信息
                                      $.ajax({
                                          async: false,
                                          url: ajaxUrl,
                                          data: "action=getshareinfo&cid=" + courseid + "&classid=" + classid + "&scoid=" + apiObj.scoid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                          dataType: "json",
                                          type: "POST",
                                          success: function (reData) {
                                              if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                                  var count = parseInt(apiObj.GetValue("cmi.interactions._count"));
                                                  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                                                      var shareNum = 0;
                                                      for (var j = 0; j < reData.sharers.length; j++) {
                                                          if (parseInt(reData.sharers[j].interactionNum) == i) {
                                                              var infostr = "cmi.interactions." + i + ".sharers." + shareNum;
                                                              apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".id", reData.sharers[j].id);
                                                              apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".name", reData.sharers[j].name);
                                                              apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".result", reData.sharers[j].result);
                                                              apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".learner_response", decodeURIComponent(reData.sharers[j].learner_response));
                                                              apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".learner_comments", null);
    
                                                              shareNum++;
                                                          }
                                                      }
                                                  }
                                              }
                                          },
                                          error: function (request, status, err) {
                                              if (status == "timeout")
                                                  throw "timeout";
                                          }
                                      });
                                  }
    
                                  function GetShareComment(apiObj, interactionNum, sharerNum) {
                                      if (classid == 0)
                                          return;
    
                                      var uid = apiObj.GetValue('cmi.interactions.' + interactionNum + '.sharers.' + sharerNum + '.id');
                                      if (uid == undefined)
                                          return;
    
                                      //获取指定交互指定分享者的打分和评论信息
                                      $.ajax({
                                          async: false,
                                          url: ajaxUrl,
                                          data: "action=getsharercomments&cid=" + courseid + "&classid=" + classid + "&sharerId=" + uid + "&scoid=" + apiObj.scoid + "&interactionNum=" + interactionNum + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                          dataType: "json",
                                          type: "POST",
                                          success: function (reData) {
                                              if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                                  var commentNum = 0;
                                                  for (var x = 0; x < reData.sharecomments.length; x++) {
                                                      var infostr = "cmi.interactions." + interactionNum + ".sharers." + sharerNum + ".learner_comments." + commentNum;
                                                      apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".isid", reData.sharecomments[x].isid);
                                                      apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".id", reData.sharecomments[x].id);
                                                      apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".name", reData.sharecomments[x].name);
                                                      apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".result", reData.sharecomments[x].result);
                                                      apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".comment", decodeURIComponent(reData.sharecomments[x].comment));
    
                                                      var replies = reData.sharecomments[x].replies;
                                                      if (replies != undefined && replies.length >
                            0) {
                            for (var y = 0; y
                            < replies.length; y++) {
                                                                apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".replies." + y + ".isrid", replies[y].isrid);
                                                                apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".replies." + y + ".id", replies[y].id);
                                                                apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".replies." + y + ".name", replies[y].name);
                                                                apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".replies." + y + ".reply", decodeURIComponent(replies[y].reply));
                                                            }
    
                                                            apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".reply_count", replies.length);
                                                        }
    
                                                        commentNum++;
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            },
                                            error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                if (status == "timeout")
                                                    throw "timeout";
                                            }
                                        });
                                    }
    
                                    function InsertShareComment(apiObj, parts, result, comment) {
                                        if (classid == 0)
                                            return;
    
                                        var sharerid = apiObj.GetValue('cmi.interactions.' + parts[2] + '.sharers.' + parts[4] + '.id');

                                            type: "POST",

                                                    apiObj.SetValue(infostr + '.id', userid);
                                                    apiObj.SetValue(infostr + '.name', username);

                                                if (status == "timeout")
                                                    throw "timeout";
                                            }
