                                    //删除指定的评论或回复
                                    function DeleteInteractionCommentOrReply(apiObj, str) {
                                        //评论回复
                                        if (str.indexOf('.replies.') != -1) {
                                            var isrid = -1;
                                            var parts = str.split('.');
    
                                            var infostr = '';
                                            for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
                                                if (parts[i] == 'replies')
                                                    break;
                                                infostr += '.' + parts[i];
                                            }
                                            if (infostr.length >
                              0)
                                                  infostr = infostr.substring(1);
    
                                              //删除对分享的评论的回复
                                              if (str.indexOf('.sharers.') != -1 && parts.length == 10) {
                                                  isrid = apiObj.GetValue(infostr + '.replies.' + parts[8] + '.isrid');
                                              }
                                              else if (parts.length == 8) //删除交互评论的回复
                                              {
                                                  isrid = apiObj.GetValue(infostr + '.replies.' + parts[6] + '.isrid');
                                              }
    
                                              if (!isNaN(isrid) && isrid > 0) {
                                                  $.ajax({
                                                      url: ajaxUrl,
                                                      data: "action=deletereply&isrid=" + isrid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                                      type: "POST",
                                                      success: function (reData) {
                                                          //更新已有回复的数量
                                                          var oldReplyCount = parseInt(apiObj.GetValue(infostr + '.reply_count'));
                                                          apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".reply_count", oldReplyCount - 1);
                                                      },
                                                      error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                          if (status == "timeout")
                                                              throw "timeout";
                                                      }
                                                  });
    
                                                  return true;
                                              }
                                          }
                                          else if (str.indexOf('.sharers.') != -1) //删除对分享的评论，包括评论下的所有回复
                                          {
                                              var parts = str.split('.');
                                              if (parts.length == 8) {
                                                  var isid = apiObj.GetValue('cmi.interactions.' + parts[2] + '.sharers.' + parts[4] + '.learner_comments.' + parts[6] + '.isid');
    
                                                  if (!isNaN(isid) && isid > 0) {
                                                      $.ajax({
                                                          url: ajaxUrl,
                                                          data: "action=deletesharecomment&isid=" + isid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                                          type: "POST",
                                                          success: function (reData) {
                                                          },
                                                          error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                              if (status == "timeout")
                                                                  throw "timeout";
                                                          }
                                                      });
    
                                                      return true;
                                                  }
                                              }
                                          }
    
                                          return false;//不能删除其它评论
                                      }
    
                                      //判断并添加评论回复，将交互评论的回复信息更新到数据库中
                                      function InsertInteractionReply(apiObj, parts) {
                                          var infostr = '';
                                          for (var i = 0; i
                              < parts.length - 1; i++) {
                                  infostr += '.' + parts[i];
                              }
                              if (infostr.length >
                                0)
                                                infostr = infostr.substring(1);
    
                                            var isrid = apiObj.GetValue(infostr + '.isrid');
    
                                            //信息齐全及isrid未设置，则判断为完整的新回复
                                            if (isrid == "") {
                                                var reply = apiObj.GetValue(infostr + '.reply');
                                                var isid = apiObj.GetValue(infostr.substring(0, infostr.indexOf('.replies.')) + '.isid');
                                                if (reply != "" && isid != "") {
                                                    $.ajax({
                                                        url: ajaxUrl,
                                                        data: "action=insertrepley&uid=" + userid + "&isid=" + isid + "&reply=" + escape(reply) + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                                        type: "POST",
                                                        success: function (reData) {
                                                            if (reData.ret == 0 && !isNaN(reData.isrid)) {
                                                                apiObj.SetValue(infostr + '.isrid', reData.isrid);
                                                                apiObj.SetValue(infostr + '.id', userid);
                                                                apiObj.SetValue(infostr + '.name', username);
                                                            }
                                                        },
                                                        error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                            if (status == "timeout")
                                                                throw "timeout";
                                                        }
                                                    });
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
    
                                        //提交待批阅的作文，设置cci.service.writing_marking.num.emp_eid
                                        function SubmitEssayMarking(apiObj, num, essay) {
                                            //courseid_scoid_序号
                                            var eguid = courseid + '_' + scoid + '_' + num;
                                            var agent = apiObj.GetValue('cci.service.writing_marking.' + num + '.agent');
                                            var question = apiObj.GetValue('cci.service.writing_marking.' + num + '.question');
    
                                            $.ajax({
                                                async: false,
                                                url: ajaxUrl,
                                                data: "action=submitessay&essay=" + escape(essay) + "&agent=" + agent + "&question=" + escape(question) + "&eguid=" + eguid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                                type: "POST",
                                                success: function (reData) {
                                                    if (reData.ret == 0)
                                                        apiObj.SetValue('cci.service.writing_marking.' + num + '.emp_eid', reData.emp_eid);
                                                },
                                                error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                    if (status == "timeout")
                                                        throw "timeout";
                                                }
                                            });
                                        }
                                        //根据emp_eid获取作文的批阅结果
                                        function GetEssayMarkingResult(apiObj, num, emp_eid) {
    
                                            var agent = apiObj.GetValue('cci.service.writing_marking.' + num + '.agent');
    
                                            var info = '';
                                            $.ajax({
                                                async: false,
                                                url: ajaxUrl,
                                                data: "action=getessayresult&emp_eid=" + emp_eid + "&agent=" + agent + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                                type: "POST",
                                                success: function (reData) {
                                                    if (reData.status == 2) //reData.status 解释详见EMPSign.cs
                                                    {
                                                        if (parseFloat(reData.degree) > 0.7)
                                                            info = "{\"score\":\"" + reData.score + "\", \"remark\":\"您提交的作文与其他作文雷同。\"}";
                                                        else
                                                            info = "{\"score\":\"" + reData.score + "\", \"remark\":\"" + decodeURIComponent(reData.comment) + "\"}";
                                                    }
                                                    else if (reData.status == 3) {
                                                        info = "{\"score\":\"0\",\"remark\":\"批阅错误：可能存在超长单词或所有单词都过短\"}";
                                                    }
                                                    else if (reData.status == 1 || reData.status == -1)
                                                        info = 6014;
                                                    else if (reData.status == 0)
                                                        info = 6013;
                                                },
                                                error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                    if (status == "timeout")
                                                        throw "timeout";
                                                }
                                            });
    
                                            return info;
                                        }

                                        function GetEssayMarkingResultDetail(apiObj, num, emp_eid) {
    
                                            var agent = apiObj.GetValue('cci.service.writing_marking.' + num + '.agent');

                                                type: "POST",
                                                success: function (reData) {
                                                    info = decodeURIComponent(reData.detail);
    
                                                    if (reData.status == 1 || reData.status == -1)
                                                        info = 6014;
                                                    else if (reData.status == 0)
                                                        info = 6013;
                                                },
                                                error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                    if (status == "timeout")
                                                        throw "timeout";
                                                }
                                            });
    
                                            return info;
                                        }
    
                                        function SubmitTranslationMarking(apiObj, num, learnerResponse) {
    
                                            var transCount = apiObj.GetValue('cci.service.translation_marking._count');
                                            if (parseInt(num) >= transCount)
                                                return;
    
                                            var patternCount = apiObj.GetValue('cci.service.translation_marking.' + num + '.correct_responses._count');
                                            if (patternCount == 0)
                                                return;
    
                                            var pattern = apiObj.GetValue('cci.service.translation_marking.' + num + '.correct_responses.0.pattern');
                                            if (pattern == '')
                                                return;
    
                                            //userid_courseid_scoid_序号
                                            var translationID = userid + '_' + courseid + '_' + scoid + '_' + num;
    
                                            var transData = '[{"id":"' + translationID + '", "qnum":"' + num + '", "answer":"' + encodeURIComponent(learnerResponse) + '", "reference":"' + encodeURIComponent(pattern) + '"}]';
    
                                            $.ajax({
                                                async: false,
                                                url: ajaxUrl,
                                                //data: "action=submittranslation&data=" + encodeURIComponent(transData) + "&id=" + translationID + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                                data: { "action": "submittranslation", "data": escape(transData), "id": translationID, "nocache": Math.random() },
                                                type: "POST",
                                                success: function (reData) {
                                                },
                                                error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                    if (status == "timeout")
                                                        throw "timeout";
                                                }
                                            });
                                        }
                                        function GetTranslationMarkingResult(apiObj, num) {
    
                                            var transCount = apiObj.GetValue('cci.service.translation_marking._count');
                                            if (parseInt(num) >= transCount)
                                                return 6013;
    
                                            var patternCount = apiObj.GetValue('cci.service.translation_marking.' + num + '.correct_responses._count');
                                            if (patternCount == 0)
                                                return 6018;
    
                                            var pattern = apiObj.GetValue('cci.service.translation_marking.' + num + '.correct_responses.0.pattern');
                                            if (pattern == '')
                                                return 6018;
    
    
                                            //userid_courseid_scoid_序号
                                            var translationID = userid + '_' + courseid + '_' + scoid + '_' + num;
    
                                            var info = '';
                                            $.ajax({
                                                async: false,
                                                url: ajaxUrl,
                                                data: "action=gettranslationresult&id=" + translationID + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                                type: "POST",
                                                success: function (reData) {
                                                    if (reData.ret == 0)
                                                        info = reData.score;
                                                    else if (reData.ret == -1)
                                                        info = 6014;
                                                },
                                                error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                    if (status == "timeout")
                                                        throw "timeout";
                                                }
                                            });
    
                                            return info;
                                        }

                                        //交互数据的记录
                                        function GetInteractionInfo(apiObj) {
                                            var interactionsInfo = '';
                                            var cmiInterCount = parseInt(apiObj.GetValue("cmi.interactions._count"));
                                            for (var i = 0; i
                                < cmiInterCount; i++) {
                                    //编号|是否分享|是否难题|escape(用户答案)|批阅结果||编号|是否分享|是否难题|escape(用户答案)|批阅结果||.....
                                    var isshared = apiObj.GetValue("cmi.interactions." + i + ".isshared");
                                    if (isshared == '')
                                        isshared = 'false';
                                    var isdifficult = apiObj.GetValue("cmi.interactions." + i + ".isdifficult");
                                    if (isdifficult == '')
                                        isdifficult = 'false';
                                    interactionsInfo += '$$' + i + '[]' + isshared + '[]';
                                    interactionsInfo += isdifficult + '[]';
                                    var learner_response = escape(apiObj.GetValue("cmi.interactions." + i + ".learner_response"));
                                    if (learner_response == '')
                                        learner_response == ' ';
                                    interactionsInfo += learner_response;
                                    interactionsInfo += '[]' + apiObj.GetValue("cmi.interactions." + i + ".result");
                                }
                                if (interactionsInfo.length >
                                  0)
                                                  interactionsInfo = interactionsInfo.substring(2);
    
                                              return interactionsInfo;
                                          }

                                          function GetClassLearners(apiObj) {
                                              if (classid == 0)
                                                  return;
    
                                              //获取班级学生的答题数据
                                              $.ajax({
                                                  async: false,
                                                  url: ajaxUrl,
                                                  data: "action=getclasslearners&classid=" + classid + "&scoid=" + apiObj.scoid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                                  dataType: "json",
                                                  type: "POST",
                                                  success: function (reData) {
                                                      if (reData.ret == 0) {
    
                                                          //学生答题数据
                                                          for (var n = 0; n
                                  < reData.learners.length; n++) {
                                                              var infostr = "cci.learners." + n;
                                                              apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".id", reData.learners[n].userid);
                                                              apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".name", reData.learners[n].name);
                                                              apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".completion_status ", reData.learners[n].completionStatus);
                                                              apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".success_status  ", reData.learners[n].successStatus);
    
                                                              if (reData.learners[n].comment == '') {
    
                                                                  apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".score.scaled", 0);
                                                                  apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".score.raw", 0);
                                                                  apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".total_time", 0);
                                                                  apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".retry_count", 0);
    
                                                              } else {
                                                                  var learnerData = eval('(' + reData.learners[n].comment + ')');
    
                                                                  apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".score.scaled", learnerData.cmi.score.scaled);
                                                                  apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".score.raw", learnerData.cmi.score.raw);
                                                                  apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".total_time", learnerData.cmi.total_time);
                                                                  apiObj.SetValue(infostr + ".retry_count", learnerData.cci.retry_count);
    
                                                                  //某学生答题数据
                                                                  var learnerInteractionCount = GetJsonKeyCount(learnerData.cmi.interactions);
    
                                                                  for (var j = 0; j < learnerInteractionCount; j++) {
    
                                                                      var interactionStr = infostr + ".interactions." + j;
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".id", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].id);
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".type", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].type);
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".learner_response", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].learner_response);
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".result", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].result);
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".play_count", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].play_count);
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".play_time", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].play_time);
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".record_count", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].record_count);
                                                                      apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".isdifficult", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].isdifficult);
    
                                                                      if (learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].teacher_comment != null) {
                                                                          if (learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].teacher_comment.id != null)
                                                                              apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".teacher_comment.id", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].teacher_comment.id);
                                                                          if (learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].teacher_comment.name != null)
                                                                              apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".teacher_comment.name", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].teacher_comment.name);
                                                                          if (learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].teacher_comment.result != null)
                                                                              apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".teacher_comment.result", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].teacher_comment.result);
                                                                          if (learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].teacher_comment.comment != null)
                                                                              apiObj.SetValue(interactionStr + ".teacher_comment.comment", learnerData.cmi.interactions[j].teacher_comment.comment);
                                                                      }
                                                                  }
                                                              }
                                                          }
                                                      }
                                                  },
                                                  error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                      if (status == "timeout")
                                                          throw "timeout";
                                                  }
                                              });
                                          }

                                          function CheckAIAppId(appid) {
                                              if (appid == undefined || appid == "") {
                                                  return true;
                                              }
                                              else {
                                                  var retVal = "false";
    
                                                  //cci.service.ai.app_id实际上是知识库ID  ，课件参数名修改不方便，沿用之前参数  NPWEB-6625
                                                  var data = {
                                                      email: "2f058608cfa34cf688f762e1591a22c8",
                                                      pipelineId: appid
                                                  }
    
                                                  $.ajax({
                                                      url: "/epapi/api/AI/CompanionPipelineExist",
                                                      data: JSON.stringify(data),
                                                      type: "POST",
                                                      contentType: "application/json",
                                                      dataType: "json",
                                                      success: function (reData) {
                                                          if (reData.status == 0) {
                                                              retVal = reData.data.isExist;
                                                          }
                                                          else
                                                              retVal = "false";
                                                      },
                                                      error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                          if (status == "timeout")
                                                              throw "timeout";
                                                      }
                                                  });
    
                                                  return retVal;
                                              }
                                          }
    
                                          function GetAIResponse(apiObj, aiPrompt) {
                                              //cci.service.ai.app_id实际上是知识库ID  ，课件参数名修改不方便，沿用之前参数  NPWEB-6625
                                              var aiAppId = apiObj.GetValue("cci.service.ai.app_id");
                                              var data = {
                                                  email: "2f058608cfa34cf688f762e1591a22c8",
                                                  pipelineIds: aiAppId,
                                                  prompt: aiPrompt,
                                                  courseId: courseid,
                                                  scoId: scoid
                                              }
    
                                              apiObj.aiResponseStatus = 'processing';
    
                                              $.ajax({
                                                  url: "/epapi/api/AI/CoursewareReply",
                                                  data: JSON.stringify(data),
                                                  type: "POST",
                                                  contentType: "application/json",
                                                  dataType: "json",
                                                  success: function (reData) {
                                                      if (reData.status == 0) {
                                                          apiObj.aiResponseStatus = 'success';
                                                          apiObj.aiResponseTemp = reData.data.content;
                                                      }
                                                      else {
                                                          apiObj.aiResponseStatus = 'error';
                                                          apiObj.aiResponseTemp = '';
                                                      }
                                                  },
                                                  error: function (request, status, err) {
                                                      if (status == "timeout")
                                                          throw "timeout";
                                                  }
                                              });
    
                                              return '';
                                          }

                                          function IsSideShowAI(scoid) {
    
                                              //清空当前AI助学的内容
                                              $('#promptDiv').empty();
                                              $('#usercontent').empty();
                                              $('#usercontent').append("<div class=\"ai-prompt-list\" id=\"promptDivHis\" style=\"display: none;\">
                                  </div>
                                  ");
                                              $('#promptDivHis').empty();
                                              $('.ai-init-wrap').show();
                                              $('.ai-record-list').hide();
                                              sessionId = "";
    
    
    
    
                                              $('#spanai').hide();
                                              needreload = true;
                
                                              $.ajax({
                                                  async: false,
                                                  url: '../Ajax/sco.aspx',
                                                  data: "action=getScoShowAI&cid=" + courseid + "&scoid=" + scoid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                                  type: "POST",
                                                  success: function (reData) {
                                                      if (reData.ret == 0 && reData.scoShowAI.toLowerCase() == "true") {
                                                          $('#spanai').show();
                                                          // needreload = true;
                                                      }
                                                  }
                                              });
                                              // }
                                          }

              <script type="text/javascript">
                var hasLoadNote = false;
                    function LoadNote(t) { //供课件学习界面调用
                        ChangeNoteView(t);
                        hasLoadNote = true;
                    }
                    function ChangeNoteView(t) {
                        notetype = t;
                        if (notetype == 'cur') {
                            $("#aTabNote2").removeClass("unit_hovertag");
                            $("#aTabNote1").addClass("unit_hovertag");
                        }
                        else {
                            $("#aTabNote1").removeClass("unit_hovertag");
                            $("#aTabNote2").addClass("unit_hovertag");
                        }
    
                        $("#ulSCONote").html('');
                        LoadSimpleNote();
                    }
    
                    var notetype = 'cur';
                    var notePageSize = 20;
                    function LoadSimpleNote() {
    
                        var min_note_id = 0;
                        var li_note = $("li[id^='li_note_']");
                        if (li_note.length > 0) {
                            min_note_id = li_note.eq(li_note.length - 1).attr("id");
                            min_note_id = min_note_id.substring(min_note_id.lastIndexOf("_") + 1);
                        }
    
                        var tempType = notetype;
                        if (notetype == 'cur') {
                            //当前笔记
                            $.getJSON("/ajax/authInfo.aspx", { "action": "getsconote", "cid":339, "scoid": scoid, "nid": min_note_id, "size": notePageSize, "nocache": Math.random() }, function (reData) {
    
                                if (reData.ret == 0 && tempType == notetype) {
                                    var html = "";
                                    for (var i = 0; i
                < reData.nlist.length; i++) {
                                        html += generateNoteHtml(reData.nlist[i]);
                                    }
                                    $("#ulSCONote").append(html);
    
                                    if (reData.nlist.length >
                  0 && reData.minid
                  < reData.nlist[reData.nlist.length - 1].id)
                                          $("#divNoteMore").show();
                                      else
                                          $("#divNoteMore").hide();
                                  }
                              });
                          }
                          else {
                              //所有笔记    
                              $.ajax({
                                  url: '/ajax/authInfo.aspx',
                                  data: "action=gn&cid=339&nid=" + min_note_id + "&size=" + notePageSize + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                  dataType: "json",
                                  success: function (reData) {
                                      if (reData.ret == 0 && tempType == notetype) {
                                          var html = "";
                                          for (var i = 0; i < reData.nlist.length; i++) {
                                              html += generateNoteHtml(reData.nlist[i]);
                                          }
                                          $("#ulSCONote").append(html);
    
                                          if (reData.nlist.length >
                    0 && reData.minid
                    < reData.nlist[reData.nlist.length - 1].id)
                                                $("#divNoteMore").show();
                                            else
                                                $("#divNoteMore").hide();
                                        }
                                    }
                                });
                            }
                        }
    
                        function SaveNote() {
    
                            var noteContent = $("#txtNote").val().replaceAll('<', '&lt;').replaceAll('>
                      ', '&gt;');
    
                              if ($.trim(noteContent) == "") {
                                  alert("请输入笔记内容");
                                  return;
                              }
                              $.ajax({
                                  url: '/ajax/authInfo.aspx ',
                                  data: "action=adnote&cid=339&scoid=" + scoid + "&content=" + escape(noteContent) + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                  type: "POST",
                                  dataType: "json",
                                  success: function (reData) {
                                      if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                          var note = { "id": reData.id, "time": reData.time, "content": noteContent.replaceAll("\n", "
                      <br/>
                      ") };
                                          var html = generateNoteHtml(note);
    
                                          var liNote = $("#ulSCONote li");
                                          if (liNote.length > 0)
                                              liNote.eq(0).before(html);
                                          else
                                              $("#ulSCONote").html(html);
    
                                          $("#txtNote").val("");
                                      }
                                  }
                              });
                          }
    
                          function DeleteNote(noteid) {
                              if (!confirm("确定删除？"))
                                  return;
    
                              $.ajax({
                                  url: '/ajax/authInfo.aspx',
                                  data: "action=dn&nid=" + noteid + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),

                                  success: function (reData) {
                                      if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                          $("#li_note_" + noteid).remove();
                                      }
                                  },
                                  error: function (a, b, c) {
                                  }
                              });
                          }
    
                          function generateNoteHtml(note) {
                              //var html = '

                      <br/>
                      ");
                      var notetime = note.isupdated ? "更新时间：" : "记录日期：";
                      notetime += note.time.substr(0, 16);

                          </span>

                        </div>

                        <!-- 笔记内容显示区域 end -->

                            <a href="javascript:;" class="btn btn-primary_1 btn-primary-gray_1 cancel-editnote-btn">取消</a>
                            \
                          </div>
                          \
                        </div >
                        \
                        <!--笔记内容编辑区域 end-->
                        \
                      </li >
                      ';
                              return html;
                          }
    
                          function editsave(_this, noteid) {
                              var noteContent = $("#txtNote_" + noteid).val().replaceAll("
                      <", "&lt;").replaceAll(">
                        ", "&gt;");
    
                                if ($.trim(noteContent) == "") {
                                    alert("不能修改内容为空的笔记!");
                                    return;
                                }
                                $.ajax({
                                    url: '/ajax/authInfo.aspx ',
                                    data: "action=modifynote&noteid=" + noteid + "&content=" + encodeURIComponent(noteContent) + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                    type: "POST",
                                    dataType: "json",
                                    success: function (reData) {
                                        if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                            var editContent = $(_this).parent().prev().find('textarea').val();
                                            $('#shownote_' + noteid).html(editContent.replaceAll("\n", "
                        <br/>
                        "));
                                            $('#notetime_' + noteid)[0].innerText = "更新时间：" + reData.time.substr(0, 16);
    
                                            var noteBox = $(_this).parents('.note');
                                            noteBox.find('.is-edit').hide();
                                            noteBox.find('.is-view').show();
                                        }
                                    },
                                    error: function (a, b, c) {
                                    }
                                });
    
    
                            }
    
                            //算字符数量
                            function countEditWords(noteid) {
                                var count = 3000;
                                var remaincount = count - $("#txtNote_" + noteid).val().length;
                                if (remaincount
                        <= 0) {
                                    $("#spWordCount_" + noteid).text("3000/3000");
                                    //低版本的IE不兼容Maxlength,改用JS截取一下
                                    $("#txtNote_" + noteid).val($("#txtNote_" + noteid).val().substr(0, count));
                                    return false;
                                }
                                $("#spWordCount_" + noteid).text($("#txtNote_" + noteid).val().length + '/3000');
                                return true;
    
                            }
    
                            /*笔记编辑 start*/
                            $('body').on('click', '.note .edit-note-btn', function () {
                                var noteBox = $(this).parents('.note');
                                noteBox.find('.is-view').hide();
                                noteBox.find('.is-edit').show();
                            });
    
                            $('body').on('click', '.note .cancel-editnote-btn', function () {
                                var noteBox = $(this).parents('.note');
                                noteBox.find('.is-edit').hide();
                                noteBox.find('.is-view').show();
                            });
                        /*笔记编辑 end*/

                      function AddDiscuss() {
                          var disContent = $("#taDiscussContent").val();
    
                          if ($.trim(disContent) == "") {
                              alert("请输入内容");
                              return;
                          }
    
                          if ("stu" != "stu" && 756167<= 0) {
                              alert("暂无班级，请创建班级后再发布问答！");
                              return;
                          }
    
                          var totea = 0;
                          if ($("#cbToTea:checked").length >
                    0)
                                totea = 1;
    
                            $.ajax({
                                url: '/ajax/authInfo.aspx ',
                                data: "action=addis&cid=339&scoid=" + scoid +"&classid=756167&content=" + escape(disContent) + "&totea=" + totea + "&nocache=" + Math.random(),
                                type: "POST",
                                dataType: "json",
                                success: function (reData) {
    
                                    if (reData.ret == 0) {
                                        var tname = decodeURIComponent(reData.tname);
                                        if (tname.length > 0)
                                            disContent = "
                    <span style='color:#00b2b0;padding-right:10px;'>@" + tname + "</span>
                    " + disContent;
    
                                        var discuss = { "id": reData.id, "time": reData.time, "location": "", "content": disContent.replaceAll("\n", "
                    <br/>
                    "), "classid": 756167, "userid": 11855022, "name": reData.name, "face": reData.face, "replyCount": 0 };
                                        var html = generateDiscussHtml(discuss);
                                        $("#ulDis").prepend(html);
    
                                        $("#taDiscussContent").val("");
                                        $("#liWordCount strong").text(500);
                                    }
                                    else if (reData.ret == -99) {
                                        alert(reData.mess);
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                        }
    
                        function generateDiscussHtml(dis) {
                            var img = 'https://courseres.sflep.com/images/user_icon.png';
                            if (dis.face != "" && dis.face != undefined)
                                img = 'https://courseres.sflep.com/resource/images/face/' + dis.face;
                            var topshow = "";
                            if (dis.topshow == 1)
                                topshow = '
                    <span style="color:#00b2b0; padding-right:10px;">[置顶]</span>
                    ';
    
                            var content = decodeURIComponent(dis.content);
                            var atTeaMark = "
                    <span style='color:#00b2b0;padding-right:10px;'>
                      ";
                      var idxAtTea = content.indexOf(atTeaMark);
                      if (idxAtTea == 0)
                          content = content.substr(0, content.indexOf("
                    </span>
                    ") + 7) + content.substr(content.indexOf("
                    </span>
                    ") + 7).replaceAll('
                    <', '&lt;').replaceAll('>
                      ', '&gt;');
                      else
                          content = content.replaceAll('
                      <', '&lt;').replaceAll('>
                        ', '&gt;');
    
                                var html = '
                        <li id="dis_' + dis.id + '">
                          '
                          + '
                          <span class="courseware_3_5">
                            <a href="../user/stuprofile.aspx?uid=' + dis.userid + '" target="_blank">
                              <img src="' + img + '"/>
                            </a>
                          </span>
                          '
                          + '
                          <span class="courseware_3_6">
                            <a href="../user/stuprofile.aspx?uid=' + dis.userid + '" target="_blank">' + dis.name + '</a>
                          </span>
                          '
                          + '
                          <span class="courseware_3_1">' + topshow + content + '</span>
                          '
                          + '
                          <span class="courseware_3_2">
                            <a href="javascript:DiscussDetail(' + dis.id + ');">参与 (' + dis.replyCount + ')</a>
                          </span>
                          ';
    
                                  if (dis.userid == 11855022)
                                      html += '
                          <span class="my_dis_3_2" style="margin-left:0; float:left; margin-top:10px; ">
                            <a href="javascript:DeleteDiscuss(' + dis.id + ');">删除</a>

                          ';
    
                                  html += '

                        ';

                            }

                function escapeHtml(unsafe) {
                    return unsafe.replace(/[&
        <>
          "']/g, function (match) {
          switch (match) {
              case '&': return '&amp;';
              case '
          <': return '&lt;';
          case '>
            ': return '&gt;';
                                case '"': return '&quot;';
                                case "'": return '&#39;';
                                default: return match;
                            }
                        });
                    }

                      //当前练习是否可使用AI伴学
                      function IsAIEnabled() {
                          if (aiSetting) {
                              var available = aiSetting.ai.available.toLowerCase();
                              if (available == "always") {
                                  return true;
                              }
                              else if (available == "completedonly") {
                                  return checkCompletionStatus();
                              }
                              else {
                                  return false;
                              }
                          }
                          else {
                              return checkCompletionStatus(true);
                          }
                      }

                          if (aiSetting) {
                              var available = aiSetting.ai.available.toLowerCase();
                              if (available === "never") {
                                  return "当前内容不允许使用AI伴学，请独自完成学习";

                      //公共方法提取
                      function checkCompletionStatus(distinguishScoredSco = false) {
                          //如果是客观练习且未完成，不允许使用AI伴学
                          if ((distinguishScoredSco && !this.isScoredSco) || false) return true;
                          var cstatus = API_1484_11.comState === "Running" ? API_1484_11.GetValue('cmi.completion_status') : "";
                          return cstatus === "completed";
                      }

                      function getGuid() {
                          var guid = "";
                          for (var i = 1; i
              <= 32; i++) {
                              var flag = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
                              //如果是偶数就设置成为
                              if (flag % 2 == 0) {
                                  //全大写
                                  var n = Math.floor(flag * 2.4) + 65;
                                  //全小写
                                  // var n = Math.floor(flag*2.4) + 97;
                                  var n = String.fromCharCode(n);
                                  guid += n;
                              } else {
                                  guid += flag;
                              }
                              // if((i==8)||(i==12)||(i==16)||(i==20))
                              //   guid += "-";
                          }
                          return guid;
                      }
    
                      function formatDate(date) {
                          const year = date.getFullYear();
                          const month = (date.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0');
                          const day = date.getDate().toString().padStart(2, '0');
                          return `${year}.${month}.${day}`;
                      }

                                  sendAIPrompt(); // 调用AI伴学发送prompt函数

                      var controller;

                      //AI伴学发送prompt，请求流式回复
                      async function sendAIPrompt(showInputText) {
                          $('#promptDivHis').hide();
                          if (lock) {
                              return false
                          }
                          lock = true;
                          var input = $("#inputPromptText").val();
                          if (input.length <= 0) {
                              alert("请输入你的问题");
                              lock = false;
                              return;
                          }
    
                          input = input.replace(/\n/g, "<br>
                ");
    
                            var showInput = showInputText || input;
    
                            $('.ai-init-wrap').hide();
                            $('.ai-record-list').show();
    
                            var display = (sessionId == "") ? 'style="border-top: 1px solid #ddd;"' : "";
                            var guid = getGuid();
                            var useContext = $('#useContext').prop('checked');
    
                            var showUseContentHtml = "";
                            if (useContext) {
                                showUseContentHtml = '
                <div class="context-box">
                  \
                  <div class="control-btn" >
                    \
                    <span class="control-btn-txt">已阅读当前上下文</span>
                    \
                    <span class="arrow-icon arrow-down"></span>
                    \
                  </div>
                  \
                  <div class="file-box" style="display: none;">
                    \
                    <span class="file-name">'+ contextfile + '</span>
                    \
                    <img src="https://courseres.sflep.com/images/icon_attach.svg" alt="">
                    \
                  </div>
                  \
                </div>
                ';
                            }
    
                            var tempAiTtml = '
                <!-- 记录条目 start -->
                \
                <div class= "ai-record-item" '+ display + ' >
                  \
                  <div class="ai-question-list">
                    \
                    <!-- 右侧对话条目 start -->
                    \
                    <div class="ai-item right-item">
                      \
                      <div class="message-box">'+ showInput + '</div>
                      \
                    </div>
                    \
                    <!-- 右侧对话条目 end -->
                    \
                    <!-- 左侧对话条目 start -->
                    \
                    <div class="ai-item left-item">
                      \
                      <div class="ai-avatar">
                        <img src="https://courseres.sflep.com/images/icon-ai.svg" alt="">
                      </div>
                      \
                      <div class="message-wrap">
                        '+ showUseContentHtml + '\
                        <div class="message-box" id="'+ guid + '"></div>
                        \
                      </div>
                      \
                      <div class="control-box"  onclick="stopStream();">
                        <span class="stop-btn">停止生成</span>
                      </div>
                      \
                    </div>
                    \
                    <!-- 左侧对话条目 end -->
                    \
                  </div>
                  \
                </div >
                \
                <!--记录条目 end-- > '
                            var $newItem = $(tempAiTtml); // 转为jQuery对象
                            var promptDiv = $('#usercontent > div.ai-prompt-list');
                            //var hasPromptDiv = $('#usercontent > div.ai-prompt-list').length > 0;
                            if (promptDiv.length > 0) {
                                promptDiv.before($newItem);
                            } else {
                                $('#usercontent').append($newItem);
                            }
    
                            $("#inputPromptText").val("");
                            RefreshLayout();
    
                            const formData = new FormData();
                            formData.append("email", "2f058608cfa34cf688f762e1591a22c8");
                            formData.append("prompt", input);
                            formData.append("scoid", scoid);
                            formData.append("courseid", 339);
                            formData.append("sessionId", sessionId);
                            //课件appId实际上是知识库ID  ，课件参数名修改不方便，沿用之前参数  NPWEB-6625
                            if (appId.length > 0) {
                                formData.append("pipelineIds", appId);
                            }
    
    
                            //var useContext = $('#useContext').prop('checked');
                            if (useContext)
                                formData.append("useContext", true);
                            else
                                formData.append("useContext", false);
    
                            // 终止之前的请求
                            if (controller) {
                                controller.abort();
                            }
                            controller = new AbortController();
                            const signal = controller.signal;
    
                            try {
                                const response = await fetch("/epapi/api/AI/CompanionReplyStream", {
                                    method: "POST",
                                    body: formData,
                                    signal: signal
                                });
    
                                // 使用可读流处理返回数据
                                const reader = response.body.getReader();
                                const decoder = new TextDecoder("utf-8");
                                let buffer = "";
    
                                var content = "";
                                while (true) {
                                    const { value, done } = await reader.read();
                                    if (done) break;
    
                                    // 将每次接收到的数据解码并追加到缓冲区
                                    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
    
                                    // 逐行解析 JSON 格式的流数据
                                    const lines = buffer.split("\n");
                                    buffer = lines.pop(); // 保留未完成的行
    
                                    for (const line of lines) {
                                        if (line.trim() === "") continue;
                                        if (line.startsWith("data:")) {
                                            const data = line.slice(5);
                                            if (data === "[DONE]") {
                                                return;
                                            }
                                            try {
                                                const json = JSON.parse(data);
                                                //if (json.code != undefined && json.code == "DataInspectionFailed")
                                                //    content += "您的提问可能包含敏感内容，请重新提问。";
                                                //else
                                                if (json.message != undefined && json.message.length > 0)
                                                    content += json.message;
                                                else {
                                                    content += json.output.text || "";
                                                    sessionId = json.output.session_id;
                                                }
    
                                                if (content) {
                                                    // 将返回内容逐字显示在网页上
                                                    $newItem.find("#" + guid).html(marked.parse(content));
                                                    RefreshLayout();
    
                                                }
                                            } catch (e) {
                                                console.error("JSON解析错误", e);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            catch (error) {
                                if (error.name === 'AbortError') {
                                    console.log('Fetch 请求被中断');
                                } else {
                                    console.error('Fetch 请求失败:', error);
                                }
                            } finally {
                                // 隐藏停止生成按钮
                                $(".ai-item.left-item .control-box").hide();
                                lock = false;
                                ShowPromptDivHtml();
                            }
                        }
    
    
                        //AI回复中调用暂停,切换练习时也会调用，切换练习时不需要加载prompt
                        function stopStream(loadprompt = true) {
                            lock = false;
                            if (controller) {
                                controller.abort();
                            }
                            if (controllerBuiltIn) {
                                controllerBuiltIn.stop(); // 调用暴露的停止接口
                            }
                            $(".ai-item.left-item .control-box").hide();
                            if (loadprompt) {
                                ShowPromptDivHtml();
                            }
                        }

                        const renderer = new marked.Renderer();
                        renderer.link = function (href) {
                            if (!href) return
                            //eslint-disable-next-line
                            const regex = new RegExp(/\b(?:https?|ftp):\/\/(?:www\.)?[-a-zA-Z0-9@:%.\+~#=]{1,256}\.[a-zA-Z0-9()]{1,6}\b(?:\/[-a-zA-Z0-9()@:%\+.~#?&//=]*)?/)
                            let link = regex.exec(href.href)
                            let match = link ? link[0] : ''
                            let str = href.href.replace(regex, '')
                            return `<a href='${match}' target='_blank'>${match}</a>${str}`
                        };
                        marked.setOptions({ renderer: renderer })
    
    
                        var controllerBuiltIn;
                        //发送内置propmt
                        function sendAiWithBuiltInPrompt(element) {
                            var input = $(element).attr("data-prompt");
                            var content = $(element).attr("data-content");
                            var inputShow = content || input;
                            var response = $(element).attr("data-response");
                            if (response.length > 0) {
                                //显示内置回答内容
                                sendAiWithBuiltInPromptFunction(inputShow, response);
                            }
                            else {
                                $("#inputPromptText").val(input);
                                sendAIPrompt(inputShow); // 调用AI伴学发送prompt函数
                            }
                        }

                    <script type="text/javascript">
                        //支持中断
                        function streamTextInSeconds($newItem, text, guid, duration) {
                            // const element = document.getElementById(elementId);
                            let isStopped = false; // 新增停止状态标志
                            let animationFrameId = null;
    
                            // 初始化与动画逻辑（同原代码）
                            const chars = text.split('');
                            var duration = duration;
                            let startTime = null;
    
                            function animate(timestamp) {
                                //if (isStopped) {
                                //    cleanUp(); // 停止时执行清理
                                //    return;
                                //}
    
                                if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
                                const elapsed = timestamp - startTime;
                                const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
                                const currentIndex = Math.floor(progress * chars.length);
    
                                //$('#' + elementId).text(chars.slice(0, currentIndex).join(''));
                                $newItem.find("#" + guid).text(chars.slice(0, currentIndex).join(''));
    
                                if (currentIndex < chars.length) {
                                    animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
                                    RefreshLayout();
                                }
                                else {
                                    // 最终清理
    
                                    //element.innerHTML = text; // 确保完整输出
                                    //$('#' + elementId).html(text);
                                    $newItem.find("#" + guid).html(text);
                                    $(".ai-item.left-item .control-box").hide();
                                    ShowPromptDivHtml();
                                }
                            }
    
                            // 新增停止方法
                            function stop() {
                                isStopped = true;
                                cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId); // 终止动画帧循环
                            }
    
                            // 资源清理函数
                            //function cleanUp() {
                            //    element.innerHTML = chars.slice(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - startTime) / duration * chars.length)).join('');
                            //    console.log('流式输出已终止');
                            //}
    
                            animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    
                            return { stop }; // 暴露停止控制接口
                        }

                        //        if (currentIndex++ >= chars.length) clearInterval(timer);
                        //    }, speed);

                    </script>

                  (function() {
                  									//答题圆环-xiaocao	
                  									var answerCardIcon = radialIndicator('#indicatorContainer_choose', {
                  										radius: 28, //定义圆形指示器的内部的圆的半径。
                  										barBgColor: "#ccc", //定义圆形指示器的刻度条的背景颜色。
                                        barColor: "#ff9b5a", //指示器数值样式
                  										barWidth: 5, //圆弧的宽度
                  										percentage: false, //设置为true显示圆形指示器的百分比数值。
                  										initValue: 0, //圆形指示器初始化的值。
                  										minValue: 0, //圆形指示器的最小值。
                  										maxValue: 100
                  									});
                                    $("#indicatorContainer_choose").data("radialIndicator", answerCardIcon);  //添加此句，用语修改夜间模式圆圈颜色
                  									//answerCardIcon.animate(8);
    
                  									//打开和关闭答题选项卡
                  									$(".answerCardIcon_choose").on("click", function() {
    										
                  										var submitted = $("[data-controltype=submit]").submitted();
                  										//if (!$("[data-controltype=submit]").submitted()){
                  											// 答题卡赋值
                  											$(".AnswerSheet li[data-refids]").each(function(){
                  												var $t = $("[data-id=" + this.getAttribute("data-refids") + "]");
                  												$(this).find("h5").text($t.valuesShow());
    												
                  													var className = "";
                  													if (submitted){
                  														switch($t.attr("data-iscorrect")){
                  															case "yes":
                  																className = "submitedCorrect";
                  																break;
                  															case "no":
                  																className = "submitedError";
                  																break;
                  														}
                  													}
    
                  													$(this).find("h5").attr("class", className);
                              
                                            //Q add-190312 答题卡中已选择的选项添加css
                                              var $answersheetli = $(this).find("h5").text();
                                              if ($answersheetli){
                                                $(this).find("h5").addClass("unsubmitChecked");
                                              }
                  											});
                  										//}
    										
                  										var $sheetSubmit = $("[data-id=AnswerSheetSubmit]");
                  										var submitHidden = $("a[data-controltype=submit]").is(":hidden");
                  										var checkHidden = $("a[data-controltype=mirrorcmd]").is(":hidden");
                  										$sheetSubmit.display(!(submitHidden && checkHidden));
                  										$sheetSubmit.text(submitHidden ? "Check" : "Submit");
    
    										
                  										$("#AnswerSheet").slideToggle();
                  									})
                  									$(".AnswerSheetClose_choose").on("click", function() {
                  										$("#AnswerSheet").slideToggle();
                  									})
    
                  									$("[data-itemtype=options] li").on("click", function(){
                  										$("#AnswerSheet").hide();
                  									});
    									
                  									// 答题卡中的提交按钮  180815按照综合进阶移动版修改，check时不显示弹窗
                                    $("[data-id=AnswerSheetSubmit]").on("click", function(){
                  										$(".AnswerSheet").hide();
                  										var $submit = $("[data-controltype=submit]").eq(0);
                  										if ($submit.is(":hidden")) $submit = $("[data-refids='" + $submit.attr("data-id") + "']").eq(0);
                  										$submit.trigger("click");
                  									});
    									
                  									// 答题卡中的重置按钮
                  									$("[data-id=AnswerSheetReset]").on("click", function(){
                  										$("#AnswerSheet").hide();
                  										$("[data-controltype=reset]").eq(0).trigger("click");
                  									});
    									
                  									// 答题卡点击题目定位
                  									$(".AnswerSheet li[data-refids]").click(function(){
                  										var $t = $("[data-id=" + this.getAttribute("data-refids") + "]");
                  										if ($t.is(":hidden")){
                  											$("[data-currentid=" + $(this).parent().parent().attr("data-part") + "]").eq(0).trigger("click", "no");
                  										}
                  										//$(".body.has_answersheet").scrollTop(0);  // 会导致iOS 产生黑屏
                  										toTop2($t, -90);
                  									});
    
                  									var ADL_INITED = false;
    
                  									// 当初始化全部完成后
                  									window["FN_AFTER_INIT"] = function(){
                  										var submitted = $("[data-controltype=submit]").submitted();
                  										if (submitted){  
                  											answerCardIcon.animate(100);
                  											//$("a[data-controltype=mirrorcmd]").hide();
                  										} else answerCardIcon.animate(0);
                  										ADL_INITED = true;
                  									}
    
                  									// 当提交后完成后
                  									window["FN_AFTER_SUBMIT"] = function() {
                  										window["FN_AFTER_INIT"]();
    
                  										$(".submiteddown").trigger("click");
                  										// 显示全部答题卡
                  										$(".answerCardIcon_choose").eq(0).trigger("click", true);
    										
                  										//$("a[data-controltype=mirrorcmd]").hide();
                  									};
    
                  									// 重置后
                  									window["FN_AFTER_RESET"] = function() {
                  										answerCardIcon.animate(0);
                                      $(".unsubmitChecked").removeClass("unsubmitChecked");  //Q add 180711-重置时清除备选卡中的选项。
                        
                                      $(".ChooseBox [data-controltype=filling]").each(function () {
                                        var $t = $(this);
                                        var $input = $t.find("input");
                                        $input.prop("readonly", true);
                                      });
                        
                                      $(".ChooseBox [data-controltype=fillinglong]").each(function () {
                                        var $t = $(this);
                                        var $textarea = $t.find("textarea");
                                        $textarea.prop("readonly", true);
                                      });
                  									};
    
                  									var $allQuestions = [];
                  									$("#AnswerSheet").find("[data-refids]").each(function() {
                  										var $q = $("[data-id=" + $(this).attr("data-refids") + "]");
                  										$allQuestions.push($q);
                  									});
    
                  									$(document).on("QUESTION_DONE", function(event, data) {
                  										var count = 0;
                  										$.each($allQuestions, function() {
                  											var v = $(this).values();
                  											if(v != null && v.length != 0 && $.trim(v[0]) != "") count = count + 100;
                  										});
                  										answerCardIcon.animate(count / $allQuestions.length);
                  									});
                  								})();
                </script>
